prompt:
Design a set of clean, consistent Unity game UI control icons, each labeled with its control name only (no other text).
Each icon should represent a specific game control element such as: Play

Style: flat.
Each icon should be simple, easily readable at small sizes, and suitable for Unity Canvas UI buttons (PNG or vector look).

Display icons on a neutral background, evenly spaced, and clearly labeled below or on the icon with its control name only (e.g., “Jump”, “Attack”).
The design should look consistent, professional, and production-ready for game HUD or menu usage.
